headline: Nigeria Foreign Exchange Reserves Reach $55.3 Billion in Late October
summary: Central bank data show Nigeria's foreign exchange reserves rose to approximately $55.26 billion on October 28, 2026, up from $54.9 billion recorded at the end of September.
why: External reserves are critical for the Central Bank of Nigeria's capacity to defend the naira and meet foreign debt servicing obligations.

impacts.name: Nigerian naira
impacts.why: An increase in central bank foreign reserves bolsters the liquidity backing the domestic currency.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
